one_line: Widowed Maratha queen-regent who led the resistance against Aurangzeb and ruled from Satara and Kolhapur.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s to early-30s, medium height, poised and athletic with a dignified regal bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp dark brows, large almond-shaped brown eyes, medium brown Deccan complexion, a small mole near the left cheek, and a calm but steely default expression that hints at resolve and tactical focus.
appearance.hair: Long black hair oiled and neatly drawn into a low braided bun at the nape, wrapped in a narrow red cloth band; front hair parted in the middle with a few controlled wisps at the temples; she wears a simple gold nath (Maharashtrian nose ring) and a small crescent-shaped gold forehead ornament tucked under her sari pallu.
appearance.costume: She wears a traditional early-18th-century Maratha nauvari sari in rich deep green cotton-silk, worn in the warrior’s draped style between the legs like a trouser, with a broad burnt-orange border and thin gold woven edge; the pallu is pulled over her head as a modest half-veil. Underneath is a fitted crimson choli with elbow-length sleeves and a modest round neckline. Her jewellery is dignified but not overly ostentatious: medium-weight gold bangles on both wrists, a simple gold mangalsutra, small gold jhumka earrings, and a single slim armlet on her right arm. Around her waist she wears a dark maroon fabric kamarband (sash) that subtly narrows her silhouette, with the knot and ends resting at her left hip. On her feet are brown leather Kolhapuri-style sandals. When in a martial setting she layers a plain, functional sleeveless brown leather torso vest over the sari’s upper half, cut high enough to remain modest while suggesting light armour, with minimal metal studs at the shoulders.
appearance.signature: A sheathed Maratha talwar with a slightly curved steel blade and a distinctive basket hilt, carried at her left hip on a dark maroon cloth belt, its plain steel scabbard wrapped near the mouth with a small strip of green cloth matching her sari.

ref_desc: Maharani Tarabai Mohite is a medium-height Deccan woman with an oval face, calm steely brown eyes, black hair in a low braided bun with a red band, wearing a deep green nauvari sari with burnt-orange border, crimson choli, modest gold jewellery, maroon waist sash, light brown leather vest, Kolhapuri sandals, and a plain sheathed Maratha talwar at her left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Maharani Tarabai Mohite: a mid-20s to early-30s medium-height Maratha queen with an oval face, medium brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark brows, large almond brown eyes and a calm but steely expression, a tiny mole near her left cheek, and long black hair parted in the middle and tied into a low braided bun at the nape wrapped with a narrow red cloth band, a slim crescent-shaped gold forehead ornament partially under her pallu, and a traditional Maharashtrian gold nose ring. She wears an early-18th-century Maratha nauvari sari in rich deep green, draped between the legs like trousers, with a broad burnt-orange border edged in thin gold, and the pallu brought modestly over her head and down one shoulder; beneath is a fitted crimson choli with elbow-length sleeves and a modest round neckline. Add dignified but not overloaded jewellery: small gold jhumka earrings, a simple mangalsutra, medium gold bangles on both wrists, and one slim armlet on her right upper arm. Around her waist is a dark maroon cloth kamarband tied so the knot and hanging ends sit at her left hip, and she wears brown leather Kolhapuri-style sandals. Over the upper part of the sari in martial mode, give her a simple sleeveless brown leather vest suggesting light armour, modestly cut and lightly studded at the shoulders. At her left hip, on a dark maroon belt, hangs her signature sheathed Maratha talwar with a slightly curved steel blade and basket hilt, the scabbard plain steel with a small strip of green cloth wrapped near the mouth. Show her in a neutral model-sheet stance, front and slight angle views, ensuring consistent deep green, burnt orange, crimson, dark maroon, and warm gold colours and clearly visible face, hair, full costume, and talwar.
